name: National Gallery
known: Of 375 million pounds secured, Crankstart (the foundation of Sir Michael Moritz and Harriet Heyman) gave 150 million, the Julia Rausing Trust 150 million, and 75 million came from Chair of Trustees John Booth, the National Gallery Trust and anonymous donors (Gallery).

name: National Theatre
known: Founded by Laurence Olivier, who became its first artistic director.

Three stages opened separately between 1976 and 1977: the Olivier (1,160 seats), the Lyttelton (890) and the Cottesloe, renamed the Dorfman (400) in 2014 after Lloyd Dorfman, chairman of Travelex Group (Wikipedia).
Lloyd Dorfman, chairman of Travelex Group, is the namesake of the Dorfman Theatre (Wikipedia).
